title: U-2 aerial photograph of Lhasa, Tibet, November 1959
description: High-contrast black-and-white aerial reconnaissance photograph showing a braided river valley and the city of Lhasa with surrounding roads and compounds. Captioned "Lhasa, Tibet, November 1959." Chapter 5 text (page 218) describes a U-2C altitude-record test flight reaching 76,400 feet and an emergency wheels-up landing at a glider-club strip near Fujisawa.
